_description: Retrieval ground truth for tqdm v2.0.0 (4d7aac9) -> v3.1.4 (d6ad58f). Each milestone from the v2.2.4 and v3.1.4 release notes is mapped to the non-merge commits whose diffs implement it. Labels were assigned by searching the diffs for the symbols involved (git log -G <symbol>) and checking each commit's changed files. The v3.3.0 milestones in the original ground truth are excluded because those commits are outside this range.

milestones.query: Added the dynamic management of the bar on window resize
better internal testing/build workflow using python setup.py make [alias]
Added smoothing feature for smooth progress bar and rate for variable changes in update times
Added maxinterval feature for unconstant update times
abstracted gui to its own class and file
Added a performance test to prevent performance regressions
